## Customer Reactivation
Reads "dormant" customers (no visit for months) from Google Sheets, filters the ones worth contacting, has the model draft a short personal message for each, saves the drafts back to the sheet and sends a Telegram summary. Drafts are reviewed by a human before sending.
**Plug in:** OpenAI, Google Sheets credentials, YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID, YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
**Test:** trigger the webhook with a few sample rows in the sheet.
